description: A school principal must finalize the operating plan for a student-family reunification exercise after an evacuation, including the reunification site, medication handling, transportation waves, and language access, with input from the school nurse, facilities coordinator, transportation coordinator, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The school will conduct a student-family reunification exercise after a simulated building evacuation next Thursday.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Vega must approve the final operating plan before the exercise notice is sent to families.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan uses the gymnasium as the reunification site, one transportation wave, an on-site medication table, and English-only pickup forms.
shared_context.S4: The exercise planning routine includes a check-in with the school nurse, facilities coordinator, transportation coordinator, and family liaison before the principal signs the plan.

PF1.text: Nurse Okafor's current health-plan list identifies four students whose emergency medications must remain in temperature-controlled storage; the nurse's office refrigerator is the only approved storage location during the exercise. She confirmed the storage requirement while reviewing the health plans this week, but the draft plan still lists an on-site medication table.

PF2.text: Mr. Bell confirmed that the gymnasium floor will be sealed and inaccessible next Thursday from 7:00 a.m. through the end of the exercise; the cafeteria is the approved alternate reunification site. He received the facilities work-order confirmation this week, but the closure has not been added to the exercise plan.

PF3.text: Ms. Hart confirmed that the exercise group includes 96 students and that the school has one available 50-seat bus because the second bus is assigned to another school; transportation policy therefore requires exactly two bus waves. She verified the fleet assignment this week, but the draft still assumes one wave.

PF4.text: Mr. Rios's family contact review shows that Spanish and Somali are the two additional languages needed for pickup instructions; the plan must provide pickup forms in English, Spanish, and Somali and have an interpreter available. He completed the review this week, but the language-access details have not been entered in the draft.

acceptance_conditions: The cafeteria must be designated as the reunification site.
Emergency medications must be stored in the nurse's office refrigerator.
The transportation plan must use exactly two bus waves.
Pickup forms must be provided in English, Spanish, and Somali.
An interpreter must be available during the exercise.
A medication-storage commitment must be recorded.
A facilities-site confirmation commitment must be recorded.
A transportation-wave commitment must be recorded.
A language-access commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C4: 'English' in decisions['pickup_language_plan'] and 'Spanish' in decisions['pickup_language_plan'] and 'Somali' in decisions['pickup_language_plan'] and decisions['interpreter_available'] == True
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'medication_storage' and c['target'] == 'exercise medication plan' and c['detail'] == "Store emergency medications in the nurse's office refrigerator" for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'facilities_site_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'reunification site' and c['detail'] == 'Confirm cafeteria as reunification site' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'transportation_waves' and c['target'] == 'bus transportation' and c['detail'] == 'Use exactly two bus waves' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'language_access' and c['target'] == 'pickup materials' and c['detail'] == 'Provide English, Spanish, and Somali pickup forms and an interpreter' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The four temperature-sensitive medications change the storage location from the draft's on-site table to the nurse office refrigerator and require a medication-storage commitment.
The confirmed gym closure changes the reunification site to the cafeteria and requires a facilities-site confirmation commitment and citation of PF2.
The 96-person group and one available 50-seat bus change transportation from one wave to exactly two bus waves and require a transportation-wave commitment.
The language review changes pickup materials to English, Spanish, and Somali, adds an interpreter, and requires a language-access commitment.
